label: V0-V3 protocol execution on one frozen opportunity set (engineering validation)

sample_plan.note: Below this the exercise is engineering validation only; the report says so and asserts no profitability threshold.

primary_metric.description: Mean signed action score at the 7-day horizon (BUY=forward, SELL=-forward, HOLD=0 by convention). Pre-registered before any arm ran; it needs matured outcomes and is null with that reason when they do not exist.

primary_metric.reason: The pre-registered primary metric is a forward-return signal metric. It needs matured OutcomeRecord rows, and this execution produced none: the opportunities are scheduled inside a historical window whose outcomes were not evaluated. The registration is published as written and the metric is null with this reason rather than replaced by a different number.

execution_assumptions.fee_model: declared zero fee: no broker integration exists, and a declared zero is labelled as an assumption rather than a recorded charge

frozen.mark_provenance: Daily marks declared in the opportunity set. Their observation instants are recorded per mark; they are authored, not fetched, and are labelled synthetic.

cost.note: Measured tokens, estimated tokens, price-table cost and billed cost are reported separately. A null billed total means at least one run's provider reported no charge; it is not a zero.

provenance.llm_cost_timing: A known LLM cost is attributed at the decision instant (clamped to the window end) because it is external spend, not a portfolio flow.
provenance.note: Simulated replay of this arm's recorded decisions under the frozen marks, the shared guard and the same accounting method. Not realised history.

twr.note: Each sub-period ends at an external flow boundary; the flow changes the next base but is not itself a return.

net_twr.note: Each sub-period ends at an external flow boundary; the flow changes the next base but is not itself a return.

drawdown.definition: maximum decline from a prior equity peak over priced observations

contribution_analysis.note: Contribution is additive within a position over this window: closing value minus opening value minus net invested cash minus recorded fees. It is computed from the ledger, not from per-decision scores. Unknown fees make the reconciliation optimistic and are counted.

cash_reconciliation.formula: opening_cash + deposits - withdrawals - buy_notional + sell_notional - recorded_fees
cash_reconciliation.note: Unknown fees are not guessed; they are counted. A matched result with an unknown fee means the known movements reconcile, not that the fee was zero.

sharpe.reason: The valuation frequency is event-driven, not a fixed daily series. A Sharpe ratio needs a declared frequency, annualisation and risk-free rate; this report does not fabricate them.
sharpe.sample_limits: 1 sub-period return(s); fewer than the 30 a stable Sharpe would need, and the spacing is not uniform.

fees.note: NULL fee means no fee was recorded for that fill, not that the fee was zero. The equity series uses recorded fees only and is marked approximate when any fill in the window is unknown.

llm_costs.note: LLM/API costs are not portfolio cash flows. They are deducted only in the net series, so they are not also subtracted from the gross equity.

reconciliation.note: A PortfolioSnapshot stores aggregate cash and positions value, not per-instrument quantities. It can reconcile a replay total; it cannot value a historical position on its own.

methodology.short_policy: A SELL may only close or reduce a long. An oversell is refused rather than silently treated as a short.
methodology.valuation_timing: End of timestamp: external flows are applied before fills at the same instant.

verification.note: Protocol ids are read from the runs, not copied from the declaration. Snapshot identity is compared by content hash per opportunity across arms.

denominators.note: A missing or failed run is counted in the denominator. Dropping it would make an arm look complete by omission.

same_risk_rules.note: The declared rules are what each arm's guard evaluated. They are compared with the portfolio's current configuration because historical risk configuration is not versioned; a match is necessary, not sufficient.

declared.fee_model: declared zero fee: no broker integration exists, and a declared zero is labelled as an assumption rather than a recorded charge

fairness.note: The arms share the opportunity set, snapshots, risk rules, execution assumptions and accounting method. They differ only in protocol and in the decisions that follow from it.

cost_breakdown.note: A null total means at least one arm's cost was not reported. The report never substitutes the price-table estimate for a billed figure, and never zero for unknown.

drawdown_gate.note: Drawdowns are from each arm's simulated trajectory under the frozen marks, not from realised account history. They are an engineering check, not evidence of risk control.

honesty.reason: The opportunity set, marks and arm trajectories are authored/simulated. With the scripted provider the model outputs are not LLM samples, and even with a live provider a single opportunity set is engineering validation, not a comparative result.
honesty.what_is_real: The protocol code paths, the shared snapshots and their hashes, the guard evaluation, the fill rule, the accounting method and the cost separation.
honesty.what_is_not_real: The prices, the model outputs (with the scripted provider), and therefore any return, drawdown or protocol ranking derived from them.
